topic: Basic Logic Gates: AND, OR and NOT
title: Logic Gates AND, OR, NOT Explained Simply | PUC and ISC
description:
Aarav presses start on the microwave and nothing happens: the door is open. It runs only when the door is shut AND start is pressed. Two conditions, one decision, made by a logic gate. In this animated lesson we meet the three basic gates and their truth tables.

On a live breadboard, two switches in a line make an AND gate, two switches side by side make an OR gate, and a switch across a lamp makes a NOT gate. The truth table fills row by row as the switch tiles toggle, the lamp lights for every 1, and an oscilloscope shows inputs A and B and the output Y switching together. We write Y = A·B, Y = A + B and Y = A bar, see why n inputs give 2^n rows, and solve a three-gate circuit step by step. Then the exam trap (in an OR gate 1 + 1 = 1, not 2), where it is asked, an original JEE Main pattern practice question with a full solution, and a fact card to screenshot.

This is Episode 52 of PUC Electronics, Class 11, Chapter 8: Introduction to Digital Electronics (Karnataka I PUC Electronics) | ISC Class 12 Computer Science: logic gates (NOT, AND, OR) and truth tables. Logic gates are no longer in the rationalised NCERT/CBSE Physics book.
